eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Enterprise unit inside Delhi (NCT) + Delhi ID; Haryana/UP NCR excluded.
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: No upper income cap for standard PMEGP
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: 15%–35% margin money subsidy based on category (Special/SC/ST/OBC/Women higher slab).
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Class 8 pass required for mfg >₹10L or service >₹5L [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Existing units already subsidized under Govt credit schemes.

benefit.summary_hi: दिल्ली के कारीगरों और नए सूक्ष्म उद्योगों को PMEGP/DKVIB के तहत सब्सिडी युक्त उद्यम ऋण और प्रशिक्षण सुविधा।
benefit.summary_en: Margin money subsidy & micro-enterprise credit facilitation for manufacturing/service units & artisans in Delhi under PMEGP/DKVIB [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
